dm.summary: I started with a look and did not reload. The Roster's "Circle formation so far" paper was up to date: parts I to V each showed 4 of 4 voted, all four personal answers were there, the toll shed text was in, and relationships stood at 7 of 11 confirmed, naming who still owes an answer. My Activity Log does list Bram's approval, so F021 (Bram's approval missing from the log) happens only on the players' side. Every part was done, and the site says waiting relationships can be accepted after the seal, so I sealed with two presses of Finalize. Result: The Whistlers, Nobody Left Behind, Candlelight, the toll-shed chapter house and the heroic question. A log line names the result. The Circle page and the charter summary updated straight away: Stitch, Refresh and Train each 5 of 5, Illumination 0/12. I sent the first dispatch in my own words (Location "Gullhaven, the estuary flats at dusk", 609 characters), named the tension clock "The fog comes in" and raised it to 1 of 4. I left the countdown timer off and am saving it for scene 3, the ferry crossing mid-channel. I posted the seal notice and the opening narration at the table (#13-14), asking each player for one action and a roll. Findings: F032 (low ux: when Finalize is armed it does not show what will be sealed, and the waiting-relationships note disappears), F033 (praise: the seal), F034 (low ux: the card says 'Dispatched at 10:30 PM' but the log uses 24-hour time, and the dispatch form number changed from 8318 to 1836 after sending). No console errors.
dm.opening: Dusk, Gullhaven. You walk out past the toll shed onto the estuary flats. The mud is grey and shining and sucks at your boots. Ahead, the old ferry chain rises out of the mud like the spine of something buried, rusted links as thick as a wrist, running out toward the channel. Beside it, a line of fresh bare footprints walks out to the water. None come back. Then the fog comes in, off the sea, low and fast, and the far bank goes. From somewhere inside it the ferry bell rings. Once. Then again, closer. The hourglass turns: The fog comes in, 1 of 4. What do you do? Bram: follow the footprints out across the mud before the fog swallows them, roll Move. Ada: the chain links are stamped with something, words, a verse; study them, roll Focus. Cass: get out along the chain unseen toward whatever is ringing that bell, roll Hide. Dev: stand still and listen to the bell, is it a bell at all, roll Sense. Spend drive if you want it; tell me your intent here and roll on the site.

dm.story_so_far: The four investigators formed the circle The Whistlers, with its chapter house in the old chain-ferry toll shed on the Gullhaven wharf. The Society's dispatch sends them after the Ferryman's Psalm: a ferry that has not run in forty years crosses on foggy nights with no one aboard. The morning after each crossing, someone in town wakes mute and writing a psalm in a stranger's hand, and two of them have walked into the estuary. At dusk the circle walks out onto the flats beside the rusted ferry chain and a line of bare footprints that go out to the channel and never come back. Then the fog rolls in and the ferry bell rings from inside it, closer each time.

Say your intent at the table, then roll the action I named on the site, spending drive if you want to. 3. If a relationship is still waiting on you (Bram: Cass's Champion; Ada: Dev's and Cass's Confidant; Dev: Cass's Stranger), try to accept it now that the circle is sealed, and log what happens.
